Kit summary

Commiserative SlashBasic
Deals 2 stages of 100% ATK DMG each to a single enemy, with a 30% chance to inflict [Inferior Severe Wound] for 2 turns. Meanwhile, restores HP by 8% of Fiona's Max HP for the ally with the lowest HP.
Gifts of GodsActiveExclusive Lv.3
Cleanses an ally's all debuffs and grants them [Block Debuff] for 2 turns. Meanwhile, increases the target's ATK by 40% for 2 turns. If the target is killed, revives the target to 32% of Fiona's Max HP and grants them [Stealth] for 1 turn.
Sword of Light Lv.3Gifts of Gods: Additionally restores an ally's HP by 20% of Fiona's Max HP when Gifts of Gods targets this ally. If the ally is dead, grants them a [Shield] by 20% of Fiona's Max HP instead.
InviolabilityPassiveExclusive Lv.1
Fiona is immune to control effects. Self gains a layer of [Grace] whenever an ally/enemy is successfully controlled or controls anyone successfully. Restores all allies' HP by 15% of Fiona's Max HP when [Grace] reaches 6 layers. Skill CD: 2 turns. [Grace] cannot be accumulated during the cooldown.
Sword of Light Lv.1When Inviolability is triggered, self Turn Meter is increased by 25%.
Glorious LightActiveExclusive Lv.2
Deals 240% ATK DMG to all enemies, with a 40% chance to inflict [Stun] for 1 turn.
Sword of Light Lv.2Glorious Light: Increases the chance to inflict [Stun] by 20%.
